maria: noticed a perf regression on staging after kernel-picker change. comm/compute overlap is gone on 8-GPU runs, all-reduce stalls appear during CUDA graph replay. nvprof shows long gaps between compute kernels and NCCL ops.

ajay: ugh, saw that too. regressed after deploy 2024-11-03, PR sha abc1234. suspect stream reuse during graph capture.

leo: can you paste profiler timeline? also which kernel-selector flags were flipped?

maria: timeline pasted below. gaps ~120ms. PR enabled 'aggressive_kernel_merge=true' and switched stream allocation to a per-batch stream pool.

sasha: quick log snippet:
```
[replay] capture_begin stream=3 flags=0x4
[replay] submit allreduce queued on stream=5
kernel launch: matmul A x B -> C (stream=3)
--- stall ---
ncclAllReduce start (stream=5) delay 126ms
```

jun: that log screams cross-stream ordering issue. CUDA graphs capture doesn't include NCCL ops on different streams unless you serialize or use child graphs. We might be losing the implicit host sync before capture end.

ajay: experiment: forcing capture on a single high-pri stream (set streamPriority=1) restores overlap but raises p50 slightly. points to stream affinity bug in replay.

maria: hypothesis: our KV prefetch schedules on background streams that get captured separately. when graph replays, prefetch launch order shifts, and kernel-selector picks a larger fused kernel that blocks comm. Proposed mitigations: 1) pin KV prefetch to the capture stream, 2) disable aggressive_kernel_merge for graph mode, 3) add explicit cudaStreamSynchronize before nccl ops as a stopgap.

leo: I'll run microbench (4/8/16 token seqs) with/without aggressive_kernel_merge and with kv_prefetch off. tagging perf infra: @sasha @ajay

deploy-bot: deployment abc1234 rolled out 2024-11-03T14:23:11Z to staging

sasha: goal: reproduce on single node with TP+PP simulation. if repro, we should add a kernel-selector guard to avoid large-kernel picks when graph mode and kv_prefetch are enabled. Also consider adding a capture-mode flag to the runtime that hints: "preserve-cross-stream-ordering".

maria: created a tiny repro and a patch that disables aggressive merging during cudaGraphCapture. pushing benchmark results to the thread after runs. thanks everyone.
